notes.title: Improvements
notes.notes:
1. Better user experience when clicking a Bible of a different testament (explained below).
2. New players start in typing mode, with a verse already selected and verses typed are remembered by default.

When a New Testament bible is currently displayed, clicking another New Testament bible replaces the current Bible (same book & chapter) but, if an Old Testament Bible is clicked, a popup will ask whether to switch to the Old Testament Bible or cancel.

Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: [Tip] Resume on Start
notes.notes:
Just a quick note:

Pick up where you left off by selecting "Resume on Start". Word2 will start with the same Bible, book and chapter that was active when you last closed the game.

You can also set/change the default language so the game starts with Bibles of that language. Clicking "Set Default Language" will set the currently active language as default.

I love Jesus!

notes.title: Replace current verses with new Bible.
notes.notes:
If verses are already displayed, clicking a Bible will replace the verses (if the clicked Bible contains the current book).

Similarly, change language and then click a bible to replace the verses for the current chapter.

To start over, there is a button to clear books and chapters.

To switch testaments, either change to a book in that testament or click the button to clear books and chapters.

Bible buttons are marked as New Testament (NT), Old Testament (OT), Complete (C).

Visual marker for the current verse (typing mode). The marker looks like a pipe ( | ).

Small UI adjustments and bug fixes.

notes.title: Beta - Requested feature.
notes.notes:
To try the beta, from Library, right-click Word2, choose properties and the beta tab; the beta will be live tomorrow if there are no issues.

If verses are already displayed, clicking a Bible will replace the verses from that Bible (if it contains the current book). 

Change language and then click a bible to replace current chapter.

To start over, there is a button to clear books and chapters.

To switch testaments, either change to a book in that testament or click the button to clear books and chapters.

Bibles are marked as New Testament (NT), Old Testament (OT), Complete (C).

Marker for current verse (typing mode).

Small UI adjustments and bug fixes.
